mapper.select: /*selectSellerMpClCatalogExcelList*/ SELECT DECODE ( (SELECT COUNT (*) FROM BYCAORGL WHERE COMORG_CODE = #{st_buyer_code}), 0, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = #{st_buyer_code}), DECODE ( (SELECT COMORG_LEVEL FROM BYCAORGL WHERE COMORG_CODE = #{st_buyer_code}), '1', (SELECT COMORG_NAME FROM BYCAORGL WHERE COMORG_CODE = #{st_buyer_code}), (SELECT COMORG_NAME FROM BYCAORGL WHERE COMORG_CODE = #{st_buyer_code}))) AS COMORG_NAME, DECODE (A.BELOW_COMORG_CODE, 'ABOVE', '그룹공통 or 회원사', 'THE_OTHERS', '외 나머지', (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = F_GET_HIDDEN_BUYER_NAME(A.BELOW_COMORG_CODE, '01'))) AS BUYER_NAME, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, A.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, A.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION, A.UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE, A.LIST_PRICE AS LIST_PRICE, A.MAKER_NAME AS MAKER_NAME, A.MAKER_PART_NO AS MAKER_PART_NO, (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M001' AND A.ORIGIN_CODE = CODE) AS ORIGIN_NAME, A.ADD_DATE AS ADD_DATE, A.CHANGE_DATE AS CHANGE_DATE, A.SELLER_ITEM_NO, DECODE ( (SELECT COUNT (*) FROM BYCAORGL WHERE COMORG_CODE = #{st_buyer_code}), 0, (SELECT COM_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = #{st_buyer_code}), DECODE ( (SELECT COMORG_LEVEL FROM BYCAORGL WHERE COMORG_CODE = #{st_buyer_code}), '1', (SELECT COMORG_CODE FROM BYCAORGL WHERE COMORG_CODE = #{st_buyer_code}), (SELECT COMORG_CODE FROM BYCAORGL WHERE COMORG_CODE = #{st_buyer_code}))) AS COMORG_CODE, A.BUYER, A.BELOW_COMORG_CODE, A.CONTRACT_NO CONTRACT_NO, A.CONTRACT_SEQ CONTRACT_SEQ FROM ICOMCQDT A, ICOMBYIT B WHERE A.BUYER = #{st_buyer_code} AND A.AGENT = #{st_com_code} AND A.DESCRIPTION LIKE '%'||#{st_description}||'%' AND A.SPECIFICATION LIKE '%'||#{st_specification}||'%' AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE '%'||#{st_buyer_item_no}||'%' AND A.STATUS <> 'D' AND B.STATUS <> 'D' AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND B.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG IN ('N', 'T') ORDER BY A.BUYER_ITEM_NO
mapper.update: INSERT INTO KEP_S_STOCK (BUYER, BUYER_ITEM_NO, SELLER, SELLER_ITEM_NO, STATUS, STOCK_QTY, CHANGE_USER_ID, CHANGE_DATE, CHANGE_TIME) VALUES (#{st_buyer}, #{st_buyer_item_no2}, #{st_com_code}, #{st_seller_item_no}, 'C', 0, #{st_user_id}, TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS'))

/*"insertSellerMpClCatalogKEPREQIMGReg"*/ INSERT INTO KEPREQIMG (AGENT ,IMG_REQ_NO ,BUYER ,BUYER_ITEM_NO ,STATUS ,IMGFILE_NAME ,IMGFILE_DIR ,DETAIL_IMGFILE_NAME ,DETAIL_IMGFILE_DIR ,ADD_DATE ,ADD_TIME ,ADD_USER_ID ,CHANGE_DATE ,CHANGE_TIME ,CHANGE_USER_ID) VALUES (#{_agentComCode}, #{IMG_REQ_NO}, #{BUYER}, #{BUYER_ITEM_NO}, 'S', #{IMGFILE_NAME}, #{IMGFILE_DIR}, #{DETAIL_IMGFILE_NAME}, #{DETAILIMGFILE_DIR}, TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS'), #{_user_id}, TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS'), #{_user_id} )
mapper.select: /*selectSellerMpClCatalogImgPopList*/ SELECT IMG.IMG_REQ_NO , IMG.BUYER , IMG.BUYER_ITEM_NO , IMG.STATUS , DECODE(IMG.STATUS,'C','승인','S','요청','R','반려') AS STATUS_NM , IMG.IMGFILE_NAME , IMG.IMGFILE_DIR , IMG.DETAIL_IMGFILE_NAME , IMG.DETAIL_IMGFILE_DIR , IMG.ADD_DATE , IMG.ADD_USER_ID , (SELECT USR.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID = IMG.ADD_USER_ID) AS ADD_USER_LOC , IMG.CONFIRM_DATE , IMG.CONFIRM_USER_ID , (SELECT USR.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID = IMG.CONFIRM_USER_ID) AS CONFIRM_NAME_LOC , IMG.REMARK FROM KEPREQIMG IMG WHERE IMG.AGENT = #{st_agent} AND IMG.BUYER_ITEM_NO = #{st_buyer_item_no} AND IMG.STATUS != 'D'

/*selectSellerMpClCatalogListV2 - 리뉴얼*/ SELECT A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS ITEM_CODE, A.DESCRIPTION AS ITEM_NAME, A.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION, A.UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT, A.LIST_PRICE AS CONTRACT_PRICE, A.MAKER_NAME AS MANUFACTURER, (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M001' AND A.ORIGIN_CODE = CODE) AS ORIGIN, A.BELOW_COMORG_CODE AS BUYER_CODE, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.BELOW_COMORG_CODE) AS BUYER_NAME, CASE WHEN B.IMGFILE_DIR IS NOT NULL AND B.IMGFILE_NAME IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(B.IMGFILE_DIR) != '' AND TRIM(B.IMGFILE_NAME) != '' THEN B.IMGFILE_DIR || B.IMGFILE_NAME ELSE '/resources/imgs/noimage.gif' END AS PRODUCT_IMAGE, CASE WHEN B.DETAIL_IMGFILE_DIR IS NOT NULL AND B.DETAIL_IMGFILE_NAME IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(B.DETAIL_IMGFILE_DIR) != '' AND TRIM(B.DETAIL_IMGFILE_NAME) != '' THEN B.DETAIL_IMGFILE_DIR || B.DETAIL_IMGFILE_NAME ELSE '/resources/imgs/noimage.gif' END AS DETAIL_IMAGE, KEP.F_GET_KEPREQIMG_STT(A.BELOW_COMORG_CODE, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, A.AGENT, 0) AS IMAGE_STATUS_CODE, KEP.F_GET_KEPREQIMG_STT(A.BELOW_COMORG_CODE, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, A.AGENT, 1) AS IMAGE_STATUS, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.ADD_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS REG_DATE, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.CHANGE_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS MOD_DATE, CASE WHEN K.IMGFILE_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN '첨부(1)' ELSE '첨부' END AS IMAGE_REGISTER, CASE WHEN K.DETAIL_IMGFILE_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN '첨부(1)' ELSE '첨부' END AS DETAIL_REGISTER,
A.CONTRACT_NO AS CONTRACT_NO, A.CONTRACT_SEQ AS CONTRACT_SEQ, A.SELLER_ITEM_NO AS SELLER_ITEM_NO, A.AGENT, DECODE (A.S_STOCK_FLAG, 'Y', '재고') AS S_STOCK_FLAG, B.IMGFILE_NAME, B.IMGFILE_DIR, B.DETAIL_IMGFILE_NAME, B.DETAIL_IMGFILE_DIR, A.BUYER AS BYIT_COMORG_CODE,
-- 추가 정보 (리뉴얼 - 팝업용) B.CATEGORY_TEXT AS CATEGORY_TEXT, B.DOC_NO AS DOC_NO, B.MSDS_YN AS MSDS_YN, B.MSDS_ATTACH_YN AS MSDS_ATTACH_YN, B.MSDS_NO AS MSDS_NO, B.DELIVERY_LT AS DELIVERY_LT FROM ICOMCQDT A INNER JOIN ICOMBYIT B ON A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO LEFT JOIN KEPREQIMG K ON A.BELOW_COMORG_CODE = K.BUYER AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = K.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND A.AGENT = K.AGENT AND K.STATUS != 'D' AND K.IMG_REQ_NO = ( SELECT MAX(K2.IMG_REQ_NO) FROM KEPREQIMG K2 WHERE K2.BUYER = K.BUYER AND K2.BUYER_ITEM_NO = K.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND K2.AGENT = K.AGENT AND K2.STATUS != 'D' ) WHERE 1=1
AND A.BUYER IN
#{item}
AND KEP.F_GET_KEPREQIMG_STT(A.BELOW_COMORG_CODE, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, A.AGENT, 0) = #{imageStatus}
AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE '%'||#{itemCode}||'%'
AND A.MAKER_NAME LIKE '%'||#{manufacturer}||'%'
AND A.DESCRIPTION LIKE '%'||#{itemName}||'%'
AND A.SPECIFICATION LIKE '%'||#{specification}||'%'
AND A.AGENT = #{st_com_code} AND A.STATUS <> 'D' AND B.STATUS <> 'D' AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND B.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG IN ('N', 'T') ORDER BY A.BUYER_ITEM_NO
